name: Johnsonville Community Centre
comment: Excellent venue; good size, plenty of facilities, slightly on the expensive side but good option.

name: Mungavin Hall
comment: Puzzling Porirua 2022 venue, good, not available Sundays, lacking in facilities, but solid option.

name: Paraparaumu Memorial Hall
comment: Good venue, albeit slightly echoey.

name: Victoria University of Wellington - AM102 and AM104
comment: Very good venue. Can get the venue for free as Jack is a student at VUW.

name: Wellington East Girls College
comment: Good - missing some tables but was used for Wellington Summer 2023 and did well.

name: Akau Tangi (formerly ASB) cntre
comment: Good - slightly awkward shape but good for 50 people.

name: Wellington Bridge Club
comment: Was used for Wellington Winter 2025 and did well. Has permanent Sunday bookings, but could work for a 1 day comp.

name: Epuni Community Hall
comment: Haven't been inside, but seems good in photos, held day 1 of Nationals 2023.

name: Karori Arts and Crafts centre
comment: Good price, can fit up to 20 people

name: Hataitai Centre (formerly Hataitai Bowling club)
comment: Too small for normal comps, but fine for PBQ comps.

name: Brooklyn Community Centre
comment: Too small for normal comps, but fine for PBQ comps.

name: KiwiClass
comment: Used for OCFMC Wellington and did well.

name: Newtown Park Function Rooms
comment: Venue website states that it is only suitable for sports-related activities, slightly overpriced and an awkward shape.

name: Wellington Indian Association halls
comment: Probably feasible for Nats, a bit on the pricey side.

name: Wellington Pipe Band Hall
comment: Feasible for a 40 person comp and decent price.

name: Berhampore School Hall
comment: Haven't been inside recently, might be a bit small, planning to check it out at some point.

name: South Wellington Intermediate School (SWIS) Hall
comment: Hall has been resurfaced, need to contact them to see if bookings can be made.

name: Vogelmorn Hall
comment: Comes with 8 tables and 50 chairs (would need to hire more), apart from that looks perfect.

name: St Patrick's Hall
comment: Photos look somewhat spartan, but could work. They aren't appearing to reply to emails about hiring their hall, but I will try again.

name: Filipino Community Centre
comment: Has permanent bookings on Saturday, mostly free on Sundays. I was quoted $360 for a 12 hour hire on Sunday.

name: Johnsonville club
comment: Was used for NZ Cubing in the Capital 2025 and did well. No requirement for a member to endorse and be present for the entire event, which is a plus.

name: Wellington College
comment: Way too expensive.

name: Knox Church
comment: Welcome to Wellington 2024 venue; was perfect, but not available Sundays and has permanent bookings on Saturdays.

name: Te Papa
comment: Way too expensive.

name: Takina Convention Centre
comment: Too expensive, (most likely even for a major).

name: Public Trust Hall
comment: Does not seem suited to our needs.

name: Aro Valley Community Centre
comment: Too small.

name: Wellington High School Hall
comment: Too big and expensive for a local competition.

name: Ngaio Town Hall
comment: Probably fine for 40 person comp, but insanely echoey even for a PBQ so don't use again.

name: Clyde Quay School Hall
comment: Hall is currently out of order. Office are unable to provide dates of when it'll be available.

name: The hub Poneke
comment: Likely too expensive for a local comp, there are regular bookings on Saturdays.

name: Petone Club
comment: On the expensive side, has limited hours, need a member to endorse and be present for the entire event.
